--- 
title: "Tutorial: Web Service Dataset Collection"
---

In this tutorial we will be looking into how CorrLang can be used 
for collecting datasets from web services.

## Prerequisites

In order to follow along with this tutorial, you should 

- have CorrLang installed 
- are familiar with JSON and CSV file formats,
- have some basic understanding of HTTP and REST web-services,
- and (ideally) you are somewhat familiar with OpenAPI/Swagger and json-schema.

## The Goal 

Let us assume you can to collect some dataset (e.g. for a machine larning task)
using _open data_ sources. In this case: REST web services.
For demonstration purposes, we will use some services that are provided by
the Norwegian cartography organization (Kartverket) and meterological institute.
Both are public organization and they publish these services under the ... license.
